WRITEfull sentences in your notebookSet A: chapter 11
A1What deal does X-Ray make with Stanley?
X-Ray asks Stanley to ...
X-Ray asks Stanley to give him anything else he finds, so that X-Ray can get the day off.
A2Why is X-Ray called X-Ray?
He is called X-Ray because ...
He is called X-Ray because it is Pig Latin for his real name, Rex.
A3Why does Stanley agree to the deal?
He agrees because it is more important that X-Ray ...
What matters more: one day off, or X-Ray liking him?
He agrees because it is more important that X-Ray thinks he is a good guy than getting one day off. X-Ray is the leader.
A4Why is it surprising that X-Ray is the leader?
It is surprising because he is not ... In fact, ...
It is surprising because he is not the biggest or the toughest. In fact, only Zero is smaller than him.
A5Why is Stanley glad that the boys call him Caveman?
He is glad because it means ...
He is glad because it means they accept him as a member of the group. At school he was bullied; here he belongs.
Extension (early finishers): was your X-Ray theory from the Tent D gallery right? Write one sentence.

WRITEfull sentences in your notebookSet B: chapter 12
B1What do the boys talk about in the circle with Mr Pendanski?
They talk about what they want to ...
They talk about what they want to do with their lives when they leave Camp Green Lake.
B2Who does Stanley blame for being here? Who does Mr Pendanski blame?
Stanley blames ___. Mr Pendanski says the person to blame is ___ .
Stanley blames his "no-good-dirty-rotten-pig-stealing-great-great-grandfather". Mr Pendanski says the person to blame is Stanley himself.
B3What does Mr Pendanski say to Zero? How does Zero react?
He says "___". Zero's smile ___ and he ___ .
Look for the key word "worthless".
He says "You're not completely worthless." Zero's smile disappears and he glares at Mr Pendanski.
B4What does Zero say he likes to do? Why is this surprising?
Zero says "___". This is surprising because ...
Zero says "I like to dig holes." This is surprising because all the other boys hate digging.
Extension (early finishers): add B3 to Mr Pendanski's Character File as more evidence that he is cruel to Zero.

Pause at: "He dug his shovel into the dirt" (repeated!) · "the letters K B" · "Stanley moved up one place in line"
WRITEfull sentences in your notebookSet C: chapter 13
C1Describe what Stanley finds.
He finds a gold ___. On the closed end there is a ___ with the letters ___ .
He finds a gold tube, about as long as his finger. On the closed end there is a heart with the letters K B inside it.
C2Why does Stanley give the tube to X-Ray?
He gives it to X-Ray because he ___ . Also, he wants X-Ray to ___ .
Remember the deal in chapter 11 (A1 and A3).
He gives it to X-Ray because he promised to give him anything he found. Also, he wants X-Ray to think he is a good guy, so the group accepts him.
C3Why does Stanley tell X-Ray to wait until tomorrow?
He tells him to wait so that X-Ray can ...
He tells him to wait so that X-Ray can pretend he found it in the morning and get the whole day off, not just an hour.
C4How does X-Ray reward Stanley? What does this show?
X-Ray moves Stanley ___ in the water line. This shows that ...
X-Ray moves Stanley up one place in the water line, in front of Zero. This shows that Stanley has moved up in the hierarchy.
C5Stretch: who do you think "K B" could be? Back it up.
I think K B could be ___ because in chapter ___ ...
Chapter 3: who robbed Stanley's great-grandfather?
I think K B could be Kissin' Kate Barlow, because in chapter 3 we learn she was a famous outlaw who robbed Stanley's great-grandfather.
C2 matters: it is a real test-style question.

X-Ray (Rex)

Detail 1: He is ___: he ___ (ch __)

Detail 1: He is the leader of Group D: he is always first in the water line (ch 10).
Detail 2: He is selfish: he makes Stanley give him anything he finds, so he can get the day off (ch 11).
